Worth it for: Choose ACT! when continuity with classic SMB ACT! workflows matters more than modern SaaS CRM ecosystems..

Avoid if: Compare HubSpot, Pipedrive, Capsule, or Freshsales for clearer cloud packaging..

If avoid signals dominate, start the alternative path with HubSpot on the same job-to-be-done.
